name: avado-ai-connect
description: AVADO AI Connect: an MCP server on the box with scoped, revocable tokens for the owner's own AI agents

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/vendor-build.mjs dist
scripts.test: rm -rf .test-build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/vendor-build.mjs .test-build/src && node --test .test-build/test/*.test.js
